statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-112323: repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests leave client state that is freed only after a 15-minute timeout, a memory exhaustion in kadmind. MIT fixed it in krb5 1.22.3 (https://mailman.mit.edu/pipermail/kerberos-announce/2026q4/000212.html; commit https://github.com/krb5/krb5/commit/8aab893c6eb17125e1518f9926bc3593cf19303c, on the 1.22 branch https://github.com/krb5/krb5/commit/ff55721f142b914ea9ccb02dabae2d679f0eff1a). MIT's fix disables the obsolete AUTH_GSSAPI server flavor, needed only by pre-1.4 clients, unless the GSSRPC_ALLOW_AUTH_GSSAPI environment variable is set; setting it re-enables the flavor and removes this protection. Alpine lists it under 1.22.3-r0 in the 3.23-stable main/krb5 APKBUILD secfixes (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/krb5/APKBUILD). This owner's published builds for Alpine 3.23 are 1.22.1-r0 and 1.22.3-r0. In the krb5-libs package of 1.22.3-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, libkrb5 reports krb5-1.22.3-final and libgssrpc contains the GSSRPC_ALLOW_AUTH_GSSAPI check; in 1.22.1-r0, built from an earlier MIT release, libgssrpc lacks it. The range ends at 1.22.3-r0, the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-112323: repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests leave client state that is freed only after a 15-minute timeout, a memory exhaustion in kadmind. MIT fixed it in krb5 1.22.3 (https://mailman.mit.edu/pipermail/kerberos-announce/2026q4/000212.html; commit https://github.com/krb5/krb5/commit/8aab893c6eb17125e1518f9926bc3593cf19303c, on the 1.22 branch https://github.com/krb5/krb5/commit/ff55721f142b914ea9ccb02dabae2d679f0eff1a). MIT's fix disables the obsolete AUTH_GSSAPI server flavor, needed only by pre-1.4 clients, unless the GSSRPC_ALLOW_AUTH_GSSAPI environment variable is set; setting it re-enables the flavor and removes this protection. Debian fixed it for trixie in 1.21.3-5+deb13u2 (DSA-6650-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-112323), a later release than the one these builds are based on. The DHI krb5 package for Debian 13 is built from Debian's 1.21.3-5+deb13u1, and the DHI Debian repository publishes three rebuilds of it; the third, the current build, backports MIT's fix. We checked libgssrpc4t64, libkrb5-3, krb5-pkinit and their debug symbols (libkrb5-dbg, krb5-pkinit-dbgsym) in all three published rebuilds for amd64 and arm64, each verified against its index checksum, with function boundaries taken from the debug symbols matched by build ID. Only the third rebuild's libgssrpc.so.4.2 contains the GSSRPC_ALLOW_AUTH_GSSAPI check, and its gssrpc__svcauth_gssapi() differs from the first two rebuilds, which are identical to each other; its package changelog records the backport of this fix, and the first two rebuilds do not list it. The range ends at the third rebuild, the first published build with the fix.
